name: Warhorse
notes: DRAFTED 2026-10-27. The ordinary mount: acquired by requisition (the standard forges' orders), by capturing a mounted enemy, or by inheritance (a fallen rider's, if it is recovered). Grants riding movement.

name: the Simurgh
notes: Canon: 5 HP/turn to rider and adjacent allies (flat, not percentage). Taken intact from the Simurgh's paralogue.
leaves_line: She arrives green and stops being green: the feather has changed hands, and the Simurgh is gone from the stable.
leaves_warning: She answers whoever holds the feather: give her to another hand while the first still lives and rides with you, and she goes.
appease_gift: a second feather, sewn into the harness
appease_line: A second feather is sewn into the harness, and the Simurgh stays green a while longer.
appease_vigil: keeps the night watch over the feather

name: the Shadhavar
notes: Canon: every turn, pulls the nearest enemy one tile toward the rider; CANNOT be turned off. A liability on escort maps, an asset on defend maps.

name: the Karkadann
notes: Canon: strong against mounted units; a devastating charge that leaves it stuck one turn. The plain one on purpose.
leaves_line: The Karkadann turns: it guards the doves, and a company that writes the Ashland off, or takes the crown's orders, is not one whose terms it can keep.
leaves_warning: It guards the doves of the Ashland, and will not carry a company that writes the Ashland off or takes the crown's orders.
appease_gift: grain for the doves, laid at its stall
appease_line: The company feeds the doves, and the Karkadann stays its terms for now.
appease_vigil: keeps watch over the doves through the night

name: the Anzu
notes: Canon: contact degrades enemy weapons; only bites what is already worn; broken means unarmed, not dead. COST: an enemy it has left unarmed drops nothing, so riding it starves your only supply line.
leaves_line: Someone has shown a literacy its rider lacks, and the Anzu turns to the one who can read the register.
leaves_warning: It follows whoever can read the register: let someone show a literacy its rider lacks and it turns to them.
appease_gift: ink and a clean page, set before it
appease_line: A clean page is set before the Anzu, and it stays with its rider.
appease_vigil: sits with the Anzu over a blank page
